verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch supports self-hosting on your own infrastructure with 'full data ownership,' which lets an AI-native user control where data physically resides by choosing their own hosting location, and offers on-prem deployment for enterprise. However, there is no evidence of a formal region-selection feature within the hosted/cloud SaaS offering itself. Missing for 10: explicit cloud region/residency selection options, documentation on data center locations for the hosted service, and any compliance certifications tied to specific regions.
